# PA Entity Lookup x402

> Pennsylvania business registry and company identity lookup for autonomous agents.

Canonical origin: https://pa-entity-x402.floot.app
OpenAPI: https://pa-entity-x402.floot.app/openapi.json
Low-cost best-match endpoint: GET https://pa-entity-x402.floot.app/_api/pa-entity-one?q=NAME
Best-match price: $0.001 USDC per successful settled lookup
Enriched search endpoint: GET https://pa-entity-x402.floot.app/_api/pa-business?q=NAME&limit=10
Enriched search price: $0.005 USDC per successful settled lookup
Protocol: x402 v2
Network: Base mainnet (eip155:8453)
Source: Pennsylvania Department of State public business-registration data via data.pa.gov

## Use this API for

- Pennsylvania business registry lookup
- company identity resolution
- legal-entity enrichment
- vendor or customer verification
- due diligence support
- filing-number lookup
- registration-type lookup
- creation-date lookup
- registered address, ZIP, and county confirmation
- source-published principal/officer role enrichment

## Choose an endpoint

For one highest-ranked entity at the lowest price:

GET /_api/pa-entity-one?q=NAME

For multiple enriched candidates:

GET /_api/pa-business?q=NAME&limit=10

Parameters:
- q: required on both routes, 2-120 characters
- limit: only on /_api/pa-business; optional integer 1-25, default 10

The $0.001 route always returns at most one result in the same result-array schema.

Matching is case-insensitive against the Pennsylvania business_name field.
The service uses a fast starts-with query first and a broader contains query only when needed.
Normalized legal-name matches are ranked before broader matches.

## Payment

The first unpaid request returns HTTP 402 with a PAYMENT-REQUIRED x402 v2 challenge.

If the payment authorization is invalid, the service returns 402 with a machine-readable reason.

If settlement is unresolved, such as settlement_pending or duplicate_settlement, retry the same request with the same PAYMENT-SIGNATURE. Do not generate a new authorization merely because a transient 503 was returned.

## Response

Each result includes:

- businessName
- filingNumber
- registrationType
- creationDate
- address1
- address2
- city
- state
- zip
- county
- countyCode
- principals[].role
- principals[].firstName
- principals[].middleName
- principals[].lastName

The response also includes enrichment.principals, source, and paid.

## Example

GET /_api/pa-entity-one?q=OpenAI

or

GET /_api/pa-business?q=OpenAI&limit=1

Representative result:

- Openai, L.l.c.
- filing number 0014371957
- Foreign Limited Liability Company
- creation date 2025-04-23
- Harrisburg, PA
- Dauphin County

## Limitations

Do not treat this API as:
- legal advice
- proof of current good standing
- sanctions screening
- a risk or legitimacy score
- independent proof of current management authority

Principal/officer rows are source-published Pennsylvania registry records.
